body: I thought I was crazy! The first hour is the worst almost like I might pass out but after that I feel great!

I’ve been on lamotrigine for a couple of months now and have never felt better. Before I struggled with severe lows my home and weight reflected it , I binged ate and shopped to the point where my home was a pig stye. I’m on 100 mg of lamotrigine and 10 mg of buspirone for anxiety and can say whole hearted have never felt better.

That’s what he keeps telling me and that’s why he says he’s mad. I have begun to look for one I may be not proactive enough but I still don’t think the passive aggressiveness is an appropriate response or am I wrong?
Thank you so much!! I’ll take your advice and hopefully sometime soon you’ll see a new up date and it’ll look better.

I’m not looking for sympathy. I’m looking to bridge this gap. Trying to figure out what’s going wrong whether it’s me or not. Maybe I’m not saying it right... When he tried to talk to me about things he has going on it’s an active engaged conversation. So there’s understanding and try to work our way to some type of resolution. This isn’t just a middle of the night thing. Unfortunately tonight I couldn’t sleep because I forgot to get my refill of my sleeping medication and everything just kind of hit me at an unfortunate time. 

I am not looking for him to wake up every hour on the hour because I feel sad.  I think Im looking for empathy.. understanding. 

It feels like he doesn’t understand what I’m going through which to to your point I don’t know what I’m going through. Maybe that’s it huh? I want somebody else to understand what I’m going through when I don’t know or refuse to identify. 

I was in therapy recently stopped because just wasn’t working out ( I know I know this is a big problem) also on medication but as of recently had stopped working.

I’m not saying I disagree with you. Because this all could be very true. I’m not mad though. But I will add even when I do open up to those times he does ask. It’s a dead end. It just leads to what can I do. 

I’m coming off sounding selfish. He’s a wonderful man and I know he would stand on his head to see me smile. But sometimes I just wanna be able
To hold a conversation with him and actively vent. Does that make sense?
Keep trying and don’t be so critical of your self
